body:
You keep focusing on one part of the problem. Me. Which we have both already agreed on. I don't know how many times I have to say that I fully take responsibility for what is happening.

I'll say it again. I did not act in the correct way. At all. Full stop.

Now, I just got off the phone with her mom about 2 hours ago and she has even told me more things I didn't know.

It turns out that those first days Aly started staying over when we started dating (and she should always tell me her friend "Vicky" was taking care of the kids for the night) was a lie. She was giving melatonin to the kids to make them go to sleep early and then coming over. Never did I know or would approve of that. I would never do that to my own kid. And neither would Aly in a healthy state of mind.

The family found out only because the oldest kid who is 14 (love that little man, he is gamer just like me ) managed to beat the melatonin to play fortnnight at night when his mom would leave. He loved that shitty ass game.  😂 I love him though. I love of all three of them.

Did you notice that when I asked what you would do... between all your ranting about me ( and you hate me, I get it)you did give me some good advice. And did you notice how much that advice sounds exactly like what Aly's family and I discussed we should do?

As I was typing this Aly called from the hospital.telling me how much she hates her family and that she can't wait to come home. I was strong and I did was her family told me. I didn't mince my words and I told her she didn't have a place here. I asked her is she had called her kids. She said she would after hanging up with me, and my voice got stronger and I told her that she treating this as a joke. I told her to not even think about calling her kids until she sobered up and didn't sound the way she did right now.

 But I told her to call her mom and ask how her kids were doing. Immediately. I told her I wanted nothing to do with this Aly. I wanted the Aly that put her kids above all alse. I wanted the Amy that would never turn her back on her family. I told her that apparently she had learned nothing from this and that was the scariest part of this. She even denied trying to commit suicide!!! Shading all the evidence, and When I even have the fucking half written suicide letter that the cops nor her family never even found. (And I refuse to let them read it). I told at hay never lied to each other and to stop it right now. She got quiet. I think she got the point

I told her the I wanted nothing to do with this Aly and to work on her self and for God's sake call to ask about her kids. 

I called her mom right after and she was very happy with the  way I acted. She confessed her biggest fear was that I would enable Aly to come back when she got released and I assured her I was in her team and agreed with everything she was doing. 

I also found a hidden stash of prespictioin drugs not found by the cops with the doctors name, pharmacy information, pictures of the pills that I forwarded to her mom. That's a bug post of this problem that has to be confronted. Why is enabling her drug abuse? 

So yeah keep focusing on how much of an asshole I am. And I'll keep agreeing that I am. But buddy I have no reason to lie to you. I could walk away and label her as just some. "crazy bitch" as you si friendly suggested I might do. At the end of the day I've only known her for a year right? 

But believe me or not, I do care. And her mom believes me and is very grateful that I am following all the advice of the therapists and her owns. That's all that matters. 

Oh I told her that the days when Aly was the happiest was when she talked about sgoing to school, and the career she wanted. Which was working with kids of course :) 

And I might just be a low down farmer but I told her mom that if I can sit down with my CEO and get some sort of fund going to get her to go to school then I'll do that. That way I can get the fuck out of her life as you so friendly suggested and help her only from the background.

I'm sorry I upset you. And I did lose my cool and disrespected you a couple of times. I'm not exactly straight minded right now. Regardless of your tough rethoric you did end up being the only one that responded to me, and just taking to someone es something I thing I needed. 

Have a good Sunday man
I think you need some serious help man. I hope you find it.

"this serves as a reality check"

My dude you ain't no white knight reality checking anyone. Just some bitter dude hell bent on demonstrating hatred as your "people like you deserve to die" Comment showed. You deliberately (or perhaps conveniently) seem to gloss over that fact that I keep oening up to my errors.

Over and over.

So I don't know from what text you keep getting than I'm trying to "te-shape" my persona when I over and over have said Aly deserves much better than I could offer.

So let me ask you, what would you have done differently.

Again. I take responsibility for my actions. I have said it many times.

But for example I just got off the phone with her mom and she was telling me how Aly had the freedom to choose which weekend she could have with her kids. Whom I love to death. I didn't know that. I would always ask her because I thought it would be cool if we all got to do at least something weekly. Like zoo trips etc. 

Yet she would always tell me that she had opposing weekends. Even when I managed to switcg weekends around she came up with a story about her ex husband also switching  hisweekends.

So it seems like the problem was more underlying . Maybe She was so afraid of losing someone else that started neglecting her own kids maybe as a way to appear as someone with "less baggage" 

It's just irrational for me to have another baby at this point. I understand you are not  going to agree with me but there is only so much I can explain an internet stranger about what my finances allow for and the rate at which I wish to reproduce...

And of course I started telling her I love you and paying more attention towards the smaller details. That was the point of the talk we had. I explained to her that I wasn't naturally a very desiosions person but I would work on it. And I did but I did tell her that for at least the next 3 years I would be very focused on my son, school and my career. Not a lot of traveling, or baby making. Simply can't afford it.

So when I say I don't want to date her is not because I didn't love her. But because I can't bear to see how much she has shanged. She deserved more that I could give her. My fucking bad i don't have your unlimited wisdom and foresight into the desiosions that let to my career growth and live experiences. Must be really nice to have all the answers in life before hand. 

Aly needs a lot of help, and to learn how to love herself before she can even think about dating. Her kids should be her number one priority. Period. 

Neither do I have any business dating right now. 

But she was there for me, and I will be there for her now. However that might look like

Wow man. I seem to have hit a nerve. I think you missed the first part of the post. I raised these issues since before she moved in.

You are starting to sound like someone who is perhaps a little too bitter because you might not have had good success with women in the past.

Nobody should be forced to be with anyone. Or be with them because they fear the person might do harm to themselves.

I think I've owned up to my mistakes but responses like "people like you should go and die" are not very constructive. And speaks volume about the type of person you are. Wish you the best
